name: Space Love!
source:
A sci-fi comedy parody of what most people think of when they think of visual novels.

Features:
* Multiple endings!
* Real-time emotions!
* Not really!
* SPACE!!!!
* Possibility of robot love!

[Edited from [url=http://www.bardinelli.com/?p=3012]official site[/url]]
translation:
一部科幻喜剧，恶搞大多数人对视觉小说的想象。

游戏特色：
* 多重结局！
* 实时情绪！
* 才怪！
* 太空！！！！
* 机器人恋爱的可能性！

[改编自[url=http://www.bardinelli.com/?p=3012]官方网站[/url]]
